doc: Keynorm cross-language parity vectors (S4b-main T1). Script-generated pins: expected outputs of training/keynorm.py, mirrored byte-identically by src/inference/keynorm.{h,cpp} and pinned from BOTH sides (tests/test_keynorm.cpp + training/tests/test_keynorm.py). Corpus-derived provenance; corpus files themselves stay absolute (normalization is a load-time view).
known_divergence: C++ shift_chords_to/from_canonical preserve type/inversion/tension in place; python shift_chords rebuilds {root, type} dicts only and DROPS inversion/tension/name keys. Corpus chords carry {root, type} only, so both sides agree on corpus data; enriched chords diverge. Phase-B fix — do NOT unify either side in a migration (touching chord-shift semantics fails review).
